description: This file contains extension methods for the EventData class from Azure.Messaging.EventHubs, adding support for streaming-specific properties such as setting and getting stream namespace, as well as serializing and deserializing event data properties.

classes.name: EventDataExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for EventData to support streaming features and property serialization.

methods.name: SetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Adds or updates the stream namespace property in an EventData instance.

methods.name: GetStreamNamespaceProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the stream namespace property from an EventData instance, or null if not present.

methods.name: SerializeProperties
methods.description: Serializes the EventData properties into a byte array, excluding the stream namespace property.

methods.name: DeserializeProperties
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into a dictionary of properties.
